title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Despite Kanmani's refusal, Mathangi permits Anbu to take her out for safety. Excited to accompany her, Anbu irritates Kanmani by playing songs while driving.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman saves Ilamathi and Nalini from a fire. After learning Siddharth wronged Nalini, he rushes them to his wedding, where Ilamathi stops it just in time.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri submits Parvathy's autopsy report in court, exposing the truth. The doctor admits the earlier report was fake and made under threat, causing Abinaya's wrongful conviction.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Deivanai assures Meenatchi that Poongodi's injury was accidental. Azhagar sees Poongodi struggling and asks Nandhini and Thenmozhi to help, triggering Deivanai's rage.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: The doctor prescribes medicines for Thangaraj as he works on his health. Shruthi shares her feelings to Mathi , and Bagyaraj promises to take Malar to her brother's function.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Karthikeyan is overjoyed when Pandian accepts his marriage with Arasi. Pandian informs his family that he has called Karthikeyan and his family for Arasi's bride-viewing.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nadesan introduces Sembaruthi to Pandian, annoying Chozhan and Nila at home. Chozhan panics over Cheran's forgotten ring, but Nila has it, triggering mockery from Pallavan.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Annamalai's family rejoices as the remarriage celebrations begin with the Mehndi function. Their happiness grows as they sing, making the occasion more exciting.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi surprises Aishwarya with a special wedding-day dinner. Aishwarya refuses Eshwari's plan to get close to Sethupathi and acquire his property.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu mistakes Shasha's gift for a present from Arjun and angrily confronts him. Meanwhile, Kasthuri stops Karthik from revealing the truth to her parents.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira turns emotional upon learning about the hardships Murugan has endured in buying her a gift. Overcoming the challenges, Murugan joyfully ties the knot with Indhira.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: An Array of Contestants Enter
description: Contestants from a wide range of profession and backgrounds audition for the round. One gets a red card, while a bunch of them succeed to secure a spot.
